The media rights rollforward failed due to a calculation error in the 'Film Rights #2710' sheet, specifically at cell O6.
The execution failed with an AssertionError in test_output.py during the call phase. While the output workbook was created with correct sheet names and order, the verifier reported 'FAIL: Film Rights #2710!O6 expected 6 got 0'. Avoid logic that results in zeroed-out values in the Film Rights sheet and ensure the node.js test script 'test_outputs.js' can correctly access required node_modules.
